initialize_MMPoseHandler: initialize the MMPoseHandler with a TorchServe context to load the pose estimation model
preprocess_MMPoseHandler: preprocess base64 encoded image data into OpenCV images for pose model inference
inference_MMPoseHandler: run pose estimation inference on images using top-down or bottom-up model detection
postprocess_MMPoseHandler: postprocess pose estimation results to extract keypoints as a list of dictionaries
review_MMPoseHandler: review the MMPoseHandler class and its TorchServe handler methods for pose estimation
